correctness.rationale: For even n=2m, the two phase-conditioned compatible sets have sizes 2^m and 2^(m+1), masses 2^-m and 2^-(m+1); odd n=2m+1 has two sets of size 2^(m+1), each cylinder mass 2^-(m+1). Both sets intersect in exactly the two fully alternating words. Inclusion-exclusion proves support; a sum of the minimum half-weight per word proves the sharp Bayes risk; the entropy chain rule with exact posterior on the overlap proves H_n. Stationarity yields I_n=2H_n-H_(2n) and the 3/2-bit limit. The first-equal-edge stopping-time mean follows from the exact alternating tail. Verified by standalone direct enumeration for every word length 1..12. Boundary n=1 and two null infinite alternating sequences are explicit. Finite checks do not replace proof.

value.rationale: The source paper exhibits a natural diffraction-hidden period-two dynamical eigenphase but accesses it using infinite observations. The theorem determines the exact finite-sample statistical cost of decoding this hidden macroscopic order, complete optimal likelihoods, and the exact predictive-information invariant 3/2 bits with parity-sensitive finite corrections. This is a motivated quantitative study of the same natural dynamical system: neither the known diffraction spectrum nor the entropy rate reveals the recovered constants. It is not claimed as a new general hidden-Markov identity, and its scope is limited to the unbiased stationary dimer process.
